Thanks for the clear scope. We can execute this purge and provide verifiable evidence. High-level plan and timeline below; I'll spin up the detailed checklist and hand off to Karthik for execution.

High-level runbook (summary):
1) Create a ticket and snapshot list of all objects linked to BETA-ACCT-3321 across prompt-output stores, kv-cache metadata, request logs.
2) Quarantine affected nodes and snapshot for internal audit (read-only) — this prevents new writes during purge.
3) Execute staged deletions: prompts/outputs -> kv-cache shards -> request logs. We delete indexed objects and then trigger storage-level expunge where applicable.
4) Run verification sweep (hash-based manifest) and collect deletion receipts from storage backends.
5) Deliver evidence bundle (encrypted zip) and provide a signed confirmation note.

Estimated timing: 36–48 hours from acceptance (shorter if we can schedule immediate maintenance window).

Attachments for your review:
- erase_playbook_v2.pdf (detailed procedural steps and rollback notes)
- audit_checklist.csv (fields of manifest we will provide)

Can you confirm the preferred evidence delivery method (S3 presigned link vs. encrypted email attachment) and the names of any third-party auditors who should be copied?
